_comment: Permanent copies of the corpus. Empty until the author publishes.
Doctrine: the concept DOI is the source line; each version DOI is one state of it.
Revisions are deposited as new versions, never as replacements — so 'concept' stays
fixed for the life of a work and 'version' changes with each deposit.
Each deposition lists the corpus slugs it covers; those texts inherit its identifiers.
Fill in and rebuild: python3 tools/build_shell.py
